import { Hono } from "hono";

// health — generated by @codai/axiom-emitters-web (web@2.0.0).

export const health = new Hono();

health.get("/health", (c) => {
  return c.json({ ok: true, method: "GET" });
});

health.post("/health", (c) => {
  return c.json({ ok: true, method: "POST" }, 201);
});

health.delete("/health", (c) => {
  return c.body(null, 204);
});

export default health;
